blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet credible human-like interaction requires more than fluent responses or persona consistency. Agents must autonomously decide whether, when, and how to communicate while adapting to evolving contexts, goals, and relationships. Existing research, however, lacks a unified approach to enabling, evaluating, and improving such capabilities in continuous, open-ended interaction.
We introduce AnthroDial , a unified framework for developing anthropomorphic social agents from three complementary aspects: MindFlow , a lightweight interaction harness that enables autonomous, asynchronous, and adaptive communication through a dynamic Mind Buffer ; CAPS-Eval , a theory-grounded framework for evaluating cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of anthropomorphic interaction; and a scalable training paradigm that combines SEEDS for environment expansion with DiAPO for adaptive capability optimization. We further construct evaluation datasets covering everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction.
Extensive experiments across diverse models and scenarios demonstrate improved interaction autonomy and naturalness, validate CAPS-Eval’s reliability, discriminativeness, and agreement with human rankings, and confirm the effectiveness of our training paradigm.
Together, these components provide a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents in open-ended interaction.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)作为社会代理人的部署越来越多,但可信的人形互动需要的不仅仅是流利的反应或个人一致性. 代理人必须自主决定是否、何时以及如何在适应不断变化的环境、目标和关系的同时进行沟通。 然而,现有研究缺乏一种统一的方法,无法在持续、开放的互动中促进、评价和改进这种能力。
我们提出AnthroDial,这是一个从三个互补方面发展人类形态社会主体的统一框架: MindFlow),一种轻量级交互控制,通过动态的Mind Buffer实现自主,同步,适应性的交流;CAPS-Eval,一个理论基础框架,用于评价人类形态相互作用的认知,情感和行为层面;以及将SEEDS用于环境扩张与DiAPO用于适应能力优化的可扩展培训范式. 我们进一步构建涵盖日常通信,游戏互动,以及长视字符互动的评价数据集.
不同模式和情景的广泛实验显示,互动自主性和自然性得到了提高,验证了CAPS-Eval的可靠性、歧视性和与人类排名的一致,并确认了我们培训模式的有效性。
这些组成部分共同提供了一个统一的框架,在不限名额的互动中发展可信的人类式社会力量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLMs increasingly serve as social interaction partners that simulate human-like personas and behavior ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) . This shift has enabled a growing range of applications, including believable agents in virtual worlds ( Park et al., 2023 ) , game characters that support player agency ( Cox & Ooi, 2024 ) , and companions that can reduce momentary loneliness ( De Freitas et al., 2026 ) and foster context-dependent feelings of closeness ( Kleinert et al., 2026 ) . These settings call for not just fluent responses, but a convincing social partner who can adapt to changing events, goals, and relationships.
blocks.zh: LLMs越来越成为模拟类似人和行为的社会互动伙伴(Shanahan等人,2023年)。 这一转变使得应用范围不断扩大,包括虚拟世界中的可信任代理(Park et al., 2023),支持玩家代理的游戏角色(Cox & Ooi, 2024),以及能够减少瞬间孤独的同伴(De Freitas et al., 2026),以及培养亲近性的上下文感(Kleinert et al., 2026). 这些环境要求的不仅仅是流利的反应,而是能够适应不断变化的事件、目标和关系的令人信服的社会伙伴。

blocks.en:
Research on LLM anthropomorphism has primarily followed two directions. One line of work treats LLMs as behavioral subjects, examining psychologically grounded traits and anthropomorphic behaviors through psychometric assessments or multi-turn interactions ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) , and evaluating whether they reproduce human behavioral and cognitive patterns through action prediction and group-level decision-making ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Binz et al., 2025 ) .
A second line of work focuses on role-playing, progressively extending persona fidelity and social behavior ( Samuel et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) to psychological consistency ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , situational adaptation and behavioral evolution ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , and digital-twin simulation across diverse scenarios ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Despite increasingly sophisticated character modeling, these studies primarily study whether a model remains faithful to a predefined role, rather than whether it behaves like a real person.
Beyond these settings, practical social interaction requires LLMs to autonomously determine whether, when, and how to communicate as situations evolve. This motivates a fundamental research question: Can LLMs become credible human-like social agents in continuous, open-ended interaction?
blocks.zh:
对LLM人类形态学的研究主要遵循两个方向. 一行工作将LLMs视为行为主体,通过心理计量评估或多转动相互作用来检查心理上基于的特征和人类形态行为(Liu等人,2026年;Ibrahim等人,2026年),并通过动作预测和群体级决策来评价它们是否复制人类行为和认知模式(Lu等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年;Binz等人,2025年)。
第二行的工作侧重于角色扮演,逐步将人格忠诚和社会行为(Samuel等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年)扩展到心理一致性(谢等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年),情境适应和行为演化(Li等人,2025年;Wei等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年b),以及跨不同情景的数字双倍模拟(Du等人,2026年). 尽管性格模型越来越精细,但这些研究主要研究一个模型是否仍然忠实于一个预先定义的角色,而不是它的行为是否像一个真实的人.
除了这些环境之外,实际的社会互动要求LLMs自主地决定是否、何时以及如何随着情况的发展进行沟通。 这引发了一个根本性的研究问题: LLMS能否在持续,不限名额的互动中成为像人类一样可靠的社会代理人?

blocks.en: Toward this goal, we face three key challenges across interaction, evaluation, and training as follows: (i) How to enable autonomous and continuous anthropomorphic interaction? Existing agent harnesses enhance interaction continuity through memory, planning, and proactive decision-making ( Park et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Deng, 2026 ) , yet they struggle to jointly coordinate the passage of time, independent participation, successive expression, and autonomous conversational initiation and closure. The key challenge is to move beyond rigid turn-taking while maintaining coherent and socially appropriate interaction. (ii) How to establish systematic and reliable evaluation dimensions? Anthropomorphism arises from the interplay among identity, situational cognition, emotions, goals, and observable behavior ( Mischel & Shoda, 1995 ) , many of which become evident only through sustained interaction ( Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) . The key challenge is to translate these abstract, latent, and dynamically evolving properties into clearly delineated and reliably observable evaluation dimensions. (iii) How to develop an effective training paradigm for multidimensional capabilities? Existing approaches simulate cognitive processes through modular multi-agent architectures ( Luo & Laban, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) , supervise response generation using explicit reasoning structures ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , or directly optimize anthropomorphic behavior through fine-tuning and reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches are respectively constrained by system complexity, dependence on predefined reasoning patterns, and difficulty balancing learning progress across anthropomorphic dimensions.
blocks.zh: 为实现这一目标,我们在互动、评价和培训方面面临以下三大挑战:(一) 如何促成自主和持续的人类形态互动? 现有代理通过记忆,规划,主动决策等手段增强互动连续性(Park et al.,2023;Liu et al.,2025;Deng,2026),然而他们却努力联合协调时间流逝,独立参与,连续表达,自主对话启动和关闭. 关键的挑战在于超越僵硬的转折,同时保持协调一致和适合社会的互动。 (二) 如何建立系统和可靠的评价层面? 从身份、情境认知、情感、目标和可观察行为之间的相互作用(Mischel & Shoda,1995年)中产生了人类形态主义,其中许多行为只有通过持续的相互作用才变得明显(Ibrahim等人,2026年)。 关键的挑战是如何将这些抽象、潜在和动态演变的特性转化为明确界定和可靠可观察的评价层面。 (三) 如何为多层面能力制定有效的培训模式? 现有方法通过模块化的多剂结构模拟认知过程(Luo & Laban,2026年;Xie等人,2025年),利用明确的推理结构监督反应生成(Wu等人,2026b;Wang等人,2026年),或通过微调和强化学习直接优化人类形态行为(Wang等人,2025a; 周等, 2026; 孙等, 2026). 然而,这些方法分别受到系统复杂性,依赖预先确定的推理模式,以及难以平衡人类形态层面的学习进展的制约.

blocks.zh: 图1: 心电图: 一种用于无限制人类形态相互作用的设计工具。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose AnthroDial , a unified framework for open-ended anthropomorphic interaction encompassing interaction, evaluation, and training .
(i) From the interaction perspective, we propose MindFlow , a lightweight harness grounded in persona and scenario cards. At its core, Mind Buffer explicitly models the intermediate state between internal formulation and external expression, including the content that the model is currently preparing to send and its scheduled delivery time.
By dynamically updating and scheduling buffered content in response to messages, silence, and time, MindFlow enables the model to autonomously sustain and advance continuous interaction beyond passive turn-taking as shown in Figure 1 .
(ii) From the evaluation perspective, we propose CAPS-Eval , a hierarchical evaluation framework for anthropomorphism grounded in the Cognitive–Affective Personality System theory (CAPS) ( Mischel & Shoda, 1995 ) . Accordingly, we construct targeted evaluation rubrics and employ LLM-based evaluators to assess these dimensions ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
(iii) From the training perspective, we propose SEEDS , a self-expanding environment synthesis method that continuously expands the space of characters, relationships, events, and situations through the bidirectional generation of persona and scenario cards, providing scalable training environments for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
Furthermore, we propose Diagnostic Adaptive Policy Optimization ( DiAPO ), which dynamically adjusts dimension-level reward weights according to the model’s historical performance on different anthropomorphic dimensions and their learnability, as inspired by the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) ( Vygotsky, 1978 ) . DiAPO guides the model to prioritize capabilities that have not yet been mastered but remain within an effective learning range, thereby promoting balanced development across multiple dimensions of anthropomorphic capability.
Finally, we construct evaluation datasets covering three representative scenarios: everyday communication , game interaction , and long-horizon character interaction . Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework across all three levels of interaction, evaluation, and training .
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个人类无限制互动、包括互动、评价和培训的统一框架。
(i) 从互动的角度出发,我们提议使用MindFlow,一种基于人和情景卡的轻量级带。 其核心是Mind Buffer明确模拟内部配制和外部表达之间的中间状态,包括该模型目前准备发送的内容及其预定的交付时间.
MindFlow通过动态更新和排程缓冲内容以响应消息,沉默,和时间,使得模型能够像图1所示,在被动转向之外自主地维持和推进持续互动.
(二) 从评价的角度来看,我们提议采用CAPS-Eval——人类形态学的等级评价框架,其基础是认知-情感人格体系理论(CAPS)(Michel & Shoda,1995年)。 因此,我们构建了目标明确的评价主题,并聘请基于LLM的评价员评估这些层面(Liu等人,2023年)。
(三)从培训角度出发,我们提出SEEDS,是一种自我扩展的环境合成方法,通过人物卡和情景卡双向生成,不断拓展人物空间,关系,事件和情况,为有监督的微调和强化学习提供可扩展的培训环境.
此外,我们提出诊断性适应政策优化(DiAPO),根据模型在不同人类形态层面的历史表现及其可学习性,动态调整维度级的奖励权重,受近缘发展区(ZPD)的启发(Vygotsky,1978年)。 DiAPO指导该模式确定尚未掌握但仍在有效学习范围内的能力的优先次序,从而促进人类形态能力多个方面的均衡发展。
最后,我们构建了涵盖三个代表性情景的评价数据集:日常交流、游戏互动和长视字符互动。 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架在所有三个层次的互动、评价和培训方面都是有效和普遍的。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Behavioral and Cognitive Evaluation. One line of research treats LLMs as behavioral subjects and investigates the extent to which they exhibit human-like psychological and cognitive patterns. Behavioral profiling characterizes personality-related tendencies through situated choices ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while AnthroBench measures observable anthropomorphic behaviors across multi-turn interactions ( Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) . Human-grounded benchmarks further compare model behavior with customer action sequences ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , population-level choice distributions ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and human responses to cognitive tasks ( Binz et al., 2025 ) . These studies primarily treat anthropomorphism as an object of analysis, rather than investigating how to develop LLMs into human-like social agents.
blocks.zh: 行为与认知评价. 一行研究将LLMs视为行为主体,并调查它们表现出人类式的心理和认知模式的程度. 行为特征分析通过位置选择来描述与人格有关的倾向(Liu等人,2026年),而Anthro Bench则通过多回合互动来衡量可观察到的人类形态行为(Ibrahim等人,2026年)。 人类基准进一步比较模型行为与客户动作序列(Lu等人,2026年),人口级选择分布(Hu等人,2026年),以及人类对认知任务的反应(Binz等人,2025年). 这些研究主要将人类形态主义作为分析对象,而不是研究如何将LLMS发展成人类式社会代理人.

blocks.en:
Role-Playing Evaluation. A second line of research evaluates whether LLMs can faithfully portray predefined personas ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) . Persona-based benchmarks assess consistency in identity, knowledge, linguistic style, and social behavior relative to character specifications ( Samuel et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Human Simulacra and HumanLLM further extend this evaluation to psychological consistency grounded in life histories and cognitive patterns ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Recent work has increasingly recognized that character consistency must coexist with situational change. Behavior-chain simulation evaluates behavioral continuity across successive situations ( Li et al., 2025 ) ; situational personality evaluation examines context-dependent personality expression ( Wei et al., 2026 ) ; and CharacterBox assesses character development in evolving virtual worlds ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . TwinVoice further evaluates digital-twin simulation across diverse interaction scenarios ( Du et al., 2026 ) . However, faithfully portraying a predefined character in these works does not necessarily imply behaving like a real person in continuous social interaction.
blocks.zh:
角色扮演评价. 第二行研究评价LLMS是否能够忠实地描绘预先定义的人(Shanahan等人,2023年)。 基于Persona的基准评估身份、知识、语言风格和社会行为与性格规范的一致性(Samuel等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年)。 人类Simulacra和HumanLLM进一步将这一评价扩展到基于生命历史和认知模式的心理一致性(Xie等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年)。
最近的工作越来越认识到,性格一致性必须与情况变化共存。 行为链模拟评价了相继发生的各种情况(Li等人,2025年)的行为连续性;情况人格评价研究了上下文依赖的个性表达(Wei等人,2026年);以及CharficBox评价了不断发展的虚拟世界中的人物发展(Wang等人,2025b年). TwinVoice进一步评价了各种相互作用情景之间的数字双倍模拟(Du等人,2026年)。 然而,在这些作品中忠实地描绘预先定义的性格并不一定意味着在持续的社会互动中表现得像一个真实的人.

blocks.en: 3 Anthropomorphism Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 人类形态基准

blocks.en: Evaluating anthropomorphism in open-ended interaction requires both eliciting autonomous social behavior and measuring it systematically. We therefore develop a benchmark comprising MindFlow , a temporally grounded interaction harness, and CAPS-Eval , a hierarchical framework for evaluating the anthropomorphic capabilities manifested in the resulting trajectories.
blocks.zh: 在开放式互动中评价人类形态,既需要引领自主的社会行为,也需要系统地衡量。 因此,我们制订了一个基准,包括MindFlow,一种基于时间的相互作用手段,以及CAPS-Eval,一个用于评估由此而形成的轨迹所表现的人类形态能力的分级框架。

blocks.en: 3.1 MindFlow
blocks.zh: 3.1 心动

blocks.en: Conventional dialogue follows a fixed receive-and-respond protocol, preventing human-like behaviors such as proactive follow-ups, successive expression, delayed responses, and natural conversational closure. We introduce MindFlow , a lightweight harness that models communication as a continuous process of forming, scheduling, revising, and expressing communicative intentions.
blocks.zh: 常规对话遵循固定的接收和响应协议,防止类似人类的行为,如主动跟进,连续表达,延迟回应,以及自然对话关闭. 我们引入了MindFlow,一种轻量级的牵引装置,将通信模型作为形成、排程、修订和表达沟通意图的连续过程。

Mind Buffer. Context and memory alone cannot preserve unexpressed intentions or reactivate an agent during silence. MindFlow therefore maintains a private Mind Buffer ℬ i t = ( u i t , τ i t ) or ∅ \mathcal{B}_{i}^{t}=(u_{i}^{t},\tau_{i}^{t})\quad\text{or}\quad\varnothing , where u i t u_{i}^{t} is the utterance being prepared and τ i t \tau_{i}^{t} is its scheduled delivery time. Before delivery, the buffered intention may be retained, revised, postponed, or canceled in response to new events. After delivery, the agent updates its buffer again, enabling follow-ups, supplementary expressions, or natural closure without requiring another incoming message.
For efficient evaluation, MindFlow uses an event-driven virtual clock that advances directly to the nearest scheduled delivery, i.e., t k + 1 = min i : ℬ i k ≠ ∅ τ i k t_{k+1}=\min_{i:\mathcal{B}_{i}^{k}\neq\varnothing}\tau_{i}^{k} . Messages sharing the same timestamp are delivered simultaneously, after which both agents update their buffers in parallel. The interaction terminates when both buffers are empty or the maximum trajectory length is reached. MindFlow thus allows agents to autonomously determine whether, when, and how to communicate while preserving temporal and causal coherence.

blocks.en: 3.2 CAPS-Eval
blocks.zh: 3.2 联合呼吁程序-Eval

blocks.en: Grounded in the CAPS theory ( Mischel & Shoda, 1995 ) , CAPS-Eval evaluates each trajectory at three levels: an L0 validity gate g g , holistic dimensions (E), and per-turn dimensions (D). The complete theoretical derivation is provided in the Appendix.

A strict gate g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) first checks hard constraints—persona facts, capability boundaries, temporal logic, output structure, medium-specific restrictions, and safety—and voids the trajectory upon any violation.
Valid trajectories are then scored along two dimension families grounded in the same state. Holistic dimensions track how Z t Z_{t} unfolds across the interaction: context consistency and scenario–relation fit follow the continuity of S S within the evolving situation M t M_{t} , social–emotional fit realizes the appraisal A t A_{t} , and proactivity and dialogue arc assess goal-directed participation under G t G_{t} and the natural development of the interaction. blocks.en: 4 Anthropomorphism Learning
blocks.zh: 4 人类学学习

blocks.en: Open-ended anthropomorphic interaction lacks diverse training environments and high-quality demonstrations, motivating a progressive framework with three shared stages. SEEDS expands the environment space, evaluation-aligned supervised fine-tuning aligns synthesized trajectories with the evaluation rubric, and DiAPO optimizes the policy via reinforcement learning. All stages share the same environment space and CAPS-Eval dimensions, connecting data synthesis, supervision, and policy optimization under a unified objective across training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 不限成员名额的人类形态互动缺乏不同的培训环境和高质量的示范,这推动了一个具有三个共同阶段的渐进框架。 SEEDS扩展了环境空间,评价对齐的有监督的微调将合成的轨迹与评价主题对齐,DiAPO通过强化学习优化了政策. 所有阶段都具有相同的环境空间和CAPS-Eval维度,将数据综合、监督和政策优化联系起来,并在整个培训和评价中实现统一的目标。

blocks.en: 4.1 Self-Expanding Environment Synthesis
blocks.zh: 4.1 自我扩展环境综合

blocks.en:
SEEDS is a data expansion method that synthesizes diverse interaction environments by binding two persona cards and one scenario card into an environment b = ( p i , p j , s k ) b=(p_{i},p_{j},s_{k}) .
It alternates between scenario-driven expansion, which samples underrepresented scenarios and constructs compatible participants, and persona-driven expansion, which extends existing personas with plausible counterparts and interaction scenarios. We retain only bindings with mutually consistent participants, relationships, events, and affective contexts, while tracking card usage and prioritizing low-frequency bindings to prevent over-representation of common interaction patterns. The resulting environment pool supports both supervised trajectory synthesis and online reinforcement learning.

SEEDS是一种数据扩展方法,通过将两个人物卡和一个情景卡捆绑到一个环境b=(pi,pj,sk)b=(p_{i},p_{j},s_{k})来合成不同的交互环境.
它在情景驱动的扩展和人驱动的扩展之间取而代之,前者对代表性不足的情景进行抽样并构建了兼容的参与者,后者将现有人与可信的对等者和互动情景延伸。 我们只保留有相互一致的参与者、关系、事件和情感背景的约束,同时跟踪卡片使用情况,并优先安排低频约束,以防止共同互动模式的代表性过高。 由此产生的环境池支持有监督的轨迹合成和在线强化学习。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Benchmarks and Scenarios. We evaluate models on three complementary scenarios constructed with the MindFlow interaction harness and scored by CAPS-Eval. Everyday Chat contains synthetic private-message dialogues across everyday topics such as relationship development, emotional support, work communication, and daily small talk. Long-Horizon Character (CLAM) tests sustained persona-driven interaction with richer background stories and longer conversational horizons. Game Interaction evaluates in-game social behavior, including game-mechanic discussions, social coordination, and account-related queries.
The three subsets use disjoint persona–scenario bindings generated or curated by SEEDS, with each case evaluated from both participant roles.
blocks.zh:
基准和设想。 我们评价用MindFlow互动手段构建的、由CAPS-Eval评分的三个互补情景模型。 每天都会 聊天包含各种日常话题的合成私人信息对话,如关系发展,情感支持,工作交流,以及日常小谈. Long-Horizon Character(CLAM)测试持续由人物驱动的互动,与更丰富的背景故事和更长的对话视野. Game Interactive评价游戏中的社会行为,包括游戏机械化的讨论,社会协调,以及与账户相关的查询.
这三个子集使用SEEDS生成或整理的不关联人物a-情景约束,每个案例都从两个参与者角色中进行评估.

blocks.en:
Models and Training Settings. We compare seven representative LLMs: Claude Opus-4.6 Thinking (Claude-4.6 Thinking), Gemini-3.5 Flash, GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Qwen3.5-9B.
Proprietary models are accessed through their respective APIs with default decoding parameters; open-weight models are run locally with temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- p p 0.9 0.9 .
For anthropomorphism learning, we take Qwen3.5-9B as the base model and apply SEEDS to synthesize training environments.
Supervised fine-tuning checkpoints are selected by validation Score on each scenario, and the best checkpoint is further optimized with DiAPO.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics. CAPS-Eval reports a validity gate, per-turn scores, and whole-dialogue scores.
We report three average-score metrics per scenario, all on a 0 0 – 1 1 scale: Score , the overall quality score combining per-turn and whole-dialogue evidence; Per-Turn , the average per-turn score; and Holistic , the average whole-dialogue score.
We additionally report thresholded pass rates ACC@ T T : a scenario passes at threshold T ∈ { 0.85 , 0.90 , 0.95 } T\in\{0.85,0.90,0.95\} when all its evaluated sides are L0-valid and reach a final score of at least T T , so ACC@85/90/95 expose how pass rates degrade as the bar rises from near-passing to near-perfect.
Unless otherwise specified, all automatic results use the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B judge to ensure a single evaluation standard across models.

Overall Results. Table 1 reports the average scores and scenario pass rates of all evaluated models on the three scenarios.
Claude-4.6 and GPT-5.5 achieve the strongest results on Long-Horizon Character, with ACC@95 of 0.8600 0.8600 and 0.9000 0.9000 and near-perfect holistic scores ( 0.99 0.99 and 0.97 0.97 ), suggesting that large proprietary models are already effective at sustaining coherent personas over extended interaction.
On Everyday Chat, all top models obtain high per-turn scores ( > 0.96 >0.96 ) and Score values above 0.9400 0.9400 , yet their ACC@95 remains modest ( ≤ 0.7800 \leq 0.7800 ), indicating that even fluent responses leave substantial headroom on the fine-grained checklist.
Game Interaction is the most challenging scenario for every model: the best proprietary system, Gemini-3.5 Flash, reaches only 0.2881 0.2881 ACC@85, and its holistic score ( 0.92 0.92 ) is much higher than its per-turn score ( 0.78 0.78 ).

blocks.en:
Performance across Scenarios. The three scenarios expose different failure modes.
Long-Horizon Character yields the highest pass rates across all thresholds, because the rubric emphasizes persona continuity and global coherence, capabilities that scale strongly with model size.
Everyday Chat produces high per-turn and holistic scores but pass rates that fall steeply between ACC@85 and ACC@95, reflecting the difficulty of satisfying every per-turn nuance in colloquial Chinese messaging.
Game Interaction is hardest because it combines local stylistic requirements with domain-specific knowledge, multi-party social reasoning, and long-arc planning; models frequently fail at least one of the evaluated dimensions.
Smaller models, especially Qwen3.5-9B, suffer from a large per-turn–holistic gap, which shows that structural failures such as repetition, malformed output, and AI-identity leakage remain a major bottleneck.

blocks.en:
Fine-Grained Capability Analysis. Figure 3 breaks down model behavior along the scenario-specific CAPS-Eval dimensions of each subset.
The radial floors are raised to 0.70 0.70 and 0.50 0.50 for Everyday Chat and Long-Horizon Character to magnify differences in their high-score regimes, whereas Game Interaction keeps the full 0 0 – 1 1 range because its dimension scores span a much wider interval.
Two patterns emerge.
In Everyday Chat and Long-Horizon Character, per-turn style and boundary dimensions are close to saturated, and the gaps concentrate in whole-dialogue dimensions: context consistency (E1) drops to 0.77 0.77 for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on Everyday Chat and to 0.59 0.59 on Long-Horizon Character, with scenario–relation fit (E2) also degrading on Long-Horizon Character.
Game Interaction instead exposes a distinct bottleneck in instant-messaging micro-style: even the strongest models collapse on the unpunctuated chat style dimension (D11, at most 0.54 0.54 ) and score markedly lower on fragmentation and immediacy (E8), which explains why this subset remains the hardest.
Together, these patterns confirm that per-turn fluency is not sufficient for anthropomorphism: tracking state changes, adapting to relationships, and reproducing human messaging micro-style are the differentiating capabilities.

Effects of Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning. Table 2 summarizes the impact of SEEDS-based SFT and DiAPO-based RL on Qwen3.5-9B across the three scenarios.
SFT lifts the base model on every scenario (e.g., Score from 0.2120 0.2120 to 0.7280 0.7280 on Long-Horizon Character), showing that SEEDS generates high-quality training environments that transfer the target interaction style.
DiAPO-based RL then pushes Score above 0.98 0.98 on all scenarios and consistently surpasses GRPO with fixed rubric weights on ACC@95, supporting the effectiveness of adaptive reweighting.
Figure 4 traces how DiAPO allocates its adaptive weights during RL on Everyday Chat.
The trajectories make the capability diagnosis visible: DiAPO concentrates weight on the dimensions it estimates as deficient, and the gains follow the weights—E1 context consistency, the dimension with the most headroom after SFT, draws the highest weight and peaks at roughly 6 6 points over GRPO, whereas near-ceiling per-turn dimensions stay close to parity.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced AnthroDial , a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents through the joint design of interaction, evaluation, and training. MindFlow enables autonomous and continuous interaction beyond rigid turn-taking. CAPS-Eval translates latent cognitive, affective, and behavioral properties into systematic and observable evaluation dimensions. Building upon them, SEEDS constructs scalable training environments, while DiAPO adaptively balances learning across anthropomorphic dimensions according to model performance and learnability.
Experiments across everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed framework.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了AnthroDial,这是一个通过共同设计互动、评价和培训来发展可信的人类型社会力量的统一框架。 MindFlow使自主和持续的相互作用超越了僵硬的旋转。 CAPS-Eval将潜在的认知,情感和行为属性转化为系统和可观察到的评价层面. 在此基础上,SEEDS构建了可扩展的培训环境,而DiAPO则根据模型性能和可学习性,适应性地平衡了跨越人类形态层面的学习.
跨越日常交流,游戏互动,以及长视字符互动的实验,都证明了拟议框架的有效性和概括性.

blocks.en: Appendix A More Details of the Anthropomorphism Benchmark

blocks.en: A.1 Data Sources and Construction
blocks.zh: A.1 数据来源和构建

blocks.en: AnthroDial comprises three complementary subsets: Everyday Chat, Game Interaction, and Long-Horizon Character. Their source material differs: Everyday Chat is constructed synthetically, Game Interaction starts from conversations collected from a game company, and Long-Horizon Character starts from publicly collected dialogue data. Across all three subsets, experts design the construction criteria and task-specific rubrics according to the common CAPS-Eval hierarchy. This shared design connects the stable persona, situational understanding, affective adaptation, communicative goals, and observable expression introduced in Section 3.2 to concrete interaction settings.
blocks.zh: AnthroDial由三个互补子集组成: 每日聊天,游戏互动,和长视字符. 它们的来源材料不同: 每天都会 Chat是合成构建的,Game Interactive从一个游戏公司收集的对话开始,Long-Horizon字符从公开收集的对话数据开始. 在所有三个子集中,专家都根据共同的CAPS-Eval等级来设计建造标准和任务特定标题. 这种共同的设计将第3.2节中引入的稳定人物a、情况理解、情感适应、交流目标以及可观察到的表达与具体的互动环境联系起来。

blocks.en: Experts manually design seed scenario cards covering everyday private-message interactions, including emotional support, relationship development, work communication, family life, shared interests, and daily small talk. Each card specifies the participants’ relationship, a triggering event, the time and setting, and each participant’s initial circumstances and emotional state. Compatible persona cards specify identity, background, personality, expression habits, interests, and knowledge boundaries. Two personas and a scenario form an environment binding ( p a , p b , s ) (p_{a},p_{b},s) . Starting from these expert-designed environments, SEEDS expands the training environment pool, and MindFlow synthesizes dialogue trajectories. The scenario establishes an interaction’s starting conditions without prescribing its conclusion or requiring a single reference response.
blocks.zh: 专家手动设计种子情景卡,涵盖日常的私人信息互动,包括情感支持,关系发展,工作沟通,家庭生活,共同利益,以及日常小谈. 每张卡片都写明参与者的关系,触发事件,时间和设置,以及每个参与者的初始情况和情绪状态. 相容的人格卡可以指定身份,背景,个性,表达习惯,兴趣,以及知识界限. 两个人和一个情景构成一个环境约束(p a, p b, s) (p_{a}, p_{b}, s). 从这些专家设计的环境开始,SEEDS扩展了培训环境池,MindFlow合成了对话轨迹. 设想方案确定互动的起始条件,而不规定其结论或要求单一的参考答复。

blocks.en: The source material consists of in-game conversations collected from a game company. Construction proceeds from observed interactions to their underlying environments: conversations are organized into interaction sessions, and persona and scenario cards are reconstructed under expert-designed specifications. Persona cards summarize role characteristics and expression habits, while scenario cards capture the relationship, interaction goal, triggering event, and relevant game context. The resulting environments include game-mechanic discussions, team coordination, social interaction, and account-related queries. Experts instantiate CAPS-Eval dimensions with criteria appropriate to this medium, such as natural use of game terminology, concise fragmented messages, coordination awareness, and knowledge and action boundaries.
blocks.zh: 源材料包括从一个游戏公司收集的游戏中的对话. 从观察到的相互作用到其基本环境的建筑收益:对话分为互动会议,个人卡和情景卡按照专家设计的规格重建。 Persona卡总结角色特征和表达习惯,而情景卡则捕捉关系,互动目标,触发事件,以及相关的游戏背景. 由此产生的环境包括游戏-机械讨论,团队协调,社会互动,以及与账户相关的查询. 专家将CAPS-Eval的维度与适合这个介质的标准进行即时分析,例如游戏术语的自然使用,简洁的零散信息,协调意识,知识和行动界限.

blocks.en: This subset uses publicly collected Chinese dialogue material, represented by the CLaM source in the data pipeline. As in Game Interaction, construction begins with collected conversations. Expert-designed specifications guide the reconstruction of persona backgrounds and scenario cards from the participants’ utterances and interaction context. The resulting environments support sustained exchanges involving personal experiences, interpersonal relationships, and evolving topics. The task-specific rubric emphasizes grounded responses, continuity of facts and context, affective appropriateness, and meaningful conversational development. Reconstructed cards are structured descriptions inferred from the source conversation; they are not independent biographical annotations of the original speakers.
blocks.zh: 这个子集使用公开收集的中文对话材料,以数据管道中的CLAM源为代表. 和Game Interactive一样,构建始于收集的对话. 由专家设计的规格指导从参与者的言论和互动背景中重建人的背景和情景卡。 由此产生的环境有助于持续交流,涉及个人经验、人际关系和不断变化的专题。 具体任务的题目强调有根据的反应、事实和背景的连续性、亲切性和有意义的对话发展。 重构的卡片是从源头对话中推断出来的结构化描述;它们不是原始演讲者的独立传记说明.

blocks.en: All three routes produce the same persona–scenario representation. This allows MindFlow to generate new interactions from either manually designed or reconstructed environments, and CAPS-Eval to assess them from each participant’s perspective. Source conversations provide evidence for environment construction in Game Interaction and Long-Horizon Character; they are distinct from the newly synthesized trajectories used for anthropomorphism learning. The expert-designed evaluation dimensions are shared across construction, trajectory filtering, and downstream evaluation, with medium-specific criteria supplying the observable evidence for each task.

blocks.en: SEEDS expands the conditions that generate training behavior. Repeated sampling from a small set of persona–scenario bindings can produce many utterances while leaving the underlying relationships and events largely unchanged. Persona–scenario expansion diversifies both the participating personas and their interaction contexts, including relationships, triggering events, and initial circumstances. A binding ( p a , p b , s ) (p_{a},p_{b},s) remains the basic unit, preserving compatibility between the participants and the situation.
blocks.zh: SEEDS扩展了生成训练行为的条件. 由一小组人a-事实约束重复取样,可以产生许多言论,而基本关系和事件基本上保持不变。 Persona-screenario扩展既使参与者个人及其互动背景多样化,包括关系、触发事件和初始情况。 约束(p a, p b, s) (p_{a}, p_{b} s) 仍然是基本单位,保持参与者与情况之间的兼容性.

blocks.en: Two generation routes address different coverage gaps. Scenario-conditioned expansion selects a branch of the fixed scenario taxonomy, creates a concrete triggering situation, and generates two personas suited to its relationship and events. Persona-conditioned expansion selects an underused existing pair and constructs a situation from their shared interests, differences, and plausible social relationship. Coverage counts guide the former toward missing or underrepresented branches, while binding histories guide the latter toward less-explored pairs. New leaf scenarios are generated within the catalog’s existing categories.
blocks.zh: 两代路线解决了不同的覆盖差距. 假想有条件的扩展会选择固定假想分类法的一个分支,产生具体的触发情况,并产生两个适合其关系和事件的人物. 以人为条件的扩张选择了未充分利用的现有对子,并从他们的共同利益、差异和可信的社会关系中构建一种局面。 覆盖范围统计指导前者走向缺失或代表性不足的分支,而约束历史则引导后者走向探索较少的对子. 新的叶子假想是在目录的现有类别内产生的。

blocks.en: Generated cards undergo checks for required fields and category membership before receiving identifiers and becoming eligible bindings. Persona and scenario quotas limit concentration on frequently reused characters or settings. Each binding also has a rejection budget. Once all eligible bindings reach their quotas or failure limits, the system creates new bindings and resumes synthesis. Scenario cards establish an interaction’s starting conditions, including events and emotional context, without prescribing its conversational conclusion.
blocks.zh: 生成的卡片在获得标识符和成为合格装订符之前,接受对所需字段和类别成员的检查. Persona和情景配额限制经常重复使用的字符或设置的浓度。 每个约束也都有否决预算. 一旦所有符合条件的约束物达到配额或失败限值,该系统就产生新的约束物并恢复合成. 假想卡设定了互动的起始条件,包括事件和情感背景,而不规定其对话结论。

blocks.en: Each DiAPO iteration collects MindFlow rollouts, scores them with the fixed CAPS-Eval rubrics, and computes training rewards using the capability estimates available at the start of the batch. These rewards guide the policy update, while the raw dimension scores update the capability estimates used in subsequent batches. This procedure adapts the training objective to prioritize underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities; benchmark evaluation continues to use the same predefined rubrics and aggregation weights across checkpoints.

Methods. ECP ( Luo & Laban, 2026 ) is the Egocentric Context Projection component of SPASM, which stores dialogue history in a perspective-agnostic representation and deterministically projects it into each agent’s egocentric view before generation, thereby mitigating persona drift in long-horizon conversations; we evaluate ECP with the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone as our base model.
HumanLM ( Wu et al., 2026a ) simulates users by aligning generated behavior with the user’s evolving internal state rather than imitating surface-level responses.
OSIM ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) is a foundation model for human behavior simulation.
All three are evaluated under the same Qwen3.5-397B-A17B judge and the same scenarios as our pipeline.
blocks.zh:
方法. ECP(Luo & Laban, 2026年)是SPASM的Egocent Control Project 组件,它将对话历史存储在视角不可知的表述中,并在一代人之前确定将它投射到每个特工的自我中心视角中,从而减轻了长视对话中的人物漂移;我们用与我们的基础模型相同的Quen3.5-9B骨干评价 ECP。
HumanLM(Wu等人,2026a)通过将生成的行为与用户不断演变的内部状态保持一致来模拟用户,而不是模仿表层响应.
OSIM(周等人,2026年)是人类行为模拟的基础模型.
这三项评估都是在同一位Quen3.5-397B-A17B法官以及与我们的管道相同的设想下进行的。

blocks.en: Results. Table 16 shows consistent gains from SEEDS-based SFT and DiAPO across the three benchmark subsets. SFT already surpasses ECP, HumanLM, and OSIM in overall Score on every subset, including ECP with the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone. The largest gap appears on Long-Horizon Character, where the strongest dialogue baseline reaches a Score of 0.1880 0.1880 , compared with 0.7280 0.7280 after SFT and 0.9930 0.9930 after DiAPO.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表16显示基于SEDS的SFT和DiAPO在三个基准子集的一致收益。 SFT已经超越了ECP,HumanLM,以及OSIM在每个子集的整体分数,包括具有相同Quen3.5-9B主干线的ECP. 最大的差距出现在"长视距"(Long-Horizon Character)上,最强的对话基线达到0.18800.1880的分数,而SFT之后的0.72800.7280和DiAPO之后的0.99300.9930.

blocks.en: DiAPO further improves upon SFT and achieves the highest overall Score and ACC@95 on each subset. Its ACC@95 reaches 0.7600 0.7600 , 0.9200 0.9200 , and 0.9661 0.9661 on Everyday Chat, Long-Horizon Character, and Game Interaction, respectively, compared with GRPO’s 0.7200 0.7200 , 0.7400 0.7400 , and 0.8814 0.8814 . These results show that anthropomorphism learning improves both average interaction quality and the proportion of scenarios in which both participants meet stringent evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: DiAPO进一步改进了SFT,并实现了每个子集的总分数最高和ACC@95. 它的ACC@95分别达到0.7600 0.7600 ,0.9200 0.9200 和0.9661 0.9661 每日聊天,长视字符和游戏互动,而GRPO的0.7200 0.7200 ,0.7400 0.7400 和0.8814 0.8814. 这些结果表明,人类形态学的学习既提高了平均互动质量,也提高了两个参与者都符合严格评价标准的情景的比例。

blocks.en: C.2 Dimension-Level Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: C.2 层面培训动态

blocks.en:
Figure 8 presents dimension-level training dynamics and aggregate performance comparisons between DiAPO and GRPO on Everyday Chat, complementing the main-text Figure 4 .
The top panels show the trajectories of individual evaluation dimensions: per-turn D1–D5 on the left and holistic E1–E5 on the right. The x x -axis denotes the rollout step, the y y -axis denotes the effective weight assigned to each dimension by DiAPO, and the z z -axis denotes its score gain over GRPO at the same training step. The translucent plane indicates zero gain, corresponding to parity with GRPO.
blocks.zh:
图8介绍了DiAPO和GRPO在每日聊天方面的一级培训动态和总体业绩比较,补充了主文图4。
顶板显示单个评价维度的轨迹:左侧为每转D1-D5,右侧为整体E1-E5. x x - 轴表示推出步骤,y - 轴表示DiAPO为每个维数分配的有效重量,z - 轴表示其在同一训练步骤上比GRPO的得分增益. 半透明平面表示零增益,与GRPO对等.

blocks.en: The bottom panels show DiAPO’s aggregate advantage over GRPO at each matched training step, measured by paired ACC@95 on the left and overall Score on the right. Each point compares the DiAPO and GRPO checkpoints from the same step. The stars mark the best checkpoints of the two methods: step 44 44 for GRPO and step 54 54 for DiAPO.
blocks.zh: 底板显示,DiAPO在每一个匹配的训练步骤上都比GRPO总优势,分别以左侧的ACC@95对和右侧的总体分数来衡量。 每一点都与DiAPO和GRPO的检查站进行比较。 星标标出两种方法的最佳检查站:GRPO的第4444步和DiAPO的第5454步.

blocks.en: The three-dimensional trajectories show that DiAPO dynamically adjusts the weights of different evaluation dimensions, with dimensions receiving larger weights tending to achieve greater gains over GRPO at later checkpoints. Consistent with these dimension-level improvements, the bottom panels show sustained improvement over GRPO during later training: the paired ACC@95 advantage becomes positive around step 24 24 and remains positive thereafter, while both aggregate gains reach their largest plotted values at step 54 54 , DiAPO’s best checkpoint. These results support DiAPO’s core premise: capability diagnosis and task–capability matching help prioritize underdeveloped yet learnable dimensions, promoting balanced multidimensional improvement and stronger overall performance.
blocks.zh: 三维轨迹显示,DiAPO动态调整了不同评价维度的权重,维度得到更大的权重,倾向于在以后的检查站比GRPO取得更大的收益. 根据这些层面的改进,底层小组在以后的培训期间显示,与GRPO相比,GRPO持续改善:组合的ACC@95的优势在步骤24前后变得积极,并在其后保持积极,而这两个总体收益在步骤5454(DiAPO的最佳检查站)达到其最大的规划值。 这些成果支持了DiAPO的核心前提:能力诊断和任务能力匹配有助于优先考虑不发达但可学习的层面,促进平衡的多层面改善和更强的整体业绩。
